scope.untracked: Explicitly included source, docs, examples and image asset; review outputs excluded.

intent: Integrate the provisional R50 18mm HDMI 1920x1080 profile through strict JSON parsing and compile-time constants into destination-to-ideal-source H, Brown k1/k2/p1/p2 mapping, existing cache and one sampling operation. Preserve default-disabled legacy behavior, exact Python integer/RTL equality, II=1, E0-to-E9 latency, reset flush and metadata order; retain deploy_to_fpga=false.

findings.suggested_fix: Separate the float-versus-fixed accuracy assertions into an unconditional test. Make scripts/run_checks.py require execution of the independent OpenCV oracle, or explicitly fail/report incomplete when it is skipped; retain OpenCV as optional for general runtime use.
findings.title: Acceptance gate passes with the independent oracle skipped
findings.why_it_matters: Without cv2, the suite skips the independent nonzero Brown-model oracle and the float-versus-fixed accuracy assertions that share its test method, yet scripts/run_checks.py can still report ALL_CHECKS_PASS and count seven lens tests. Separate unconditional numerical assertions from the optional import, and require the independent oracle in the acceptance gate so an incomplete run cannot look fully verified. The current delivery ran with cv2 present, so its recorded numerical evidence remains valid.
